label: FIXTURE — official examples. Built from the `example` values of the FoodData Central OpenAPI spec 1.0.0 (read from the public documentation page; no API call). Not fetched food records and not nutrition data.
note: Each file is the schema's own example values assembled into one object (nested $ref examples included). The spec's examples are illustrative: e.g. the FoodNutrient example carries nutrient number "305" with the name "Carbohydrate, by difference" and an amount of "0E-8". They are kept exactly as the spec states them, which is why most macro values here are unknown.

records.schema: BrandedFoodItem (with FoodNutrient, Nutrient, FoodNutrientDerivation, NutrientAnalysisDetails examples)
FoundationFoodItem (with FoodCategory, FoodNutrient, FoodPortion, MeasureUnit examples)
SurveyFoodItem (with FoodPortion, MeasureUnit, WweiaFoodCategory examples; the spec spells the key `datatype`)
POST /v1/foods/search 200 response: array of SearchResult with one SearchResultFood and AbridgedFoodNutrient example (the live API returns a single object; the spec says array)
